newsitem.title: UK: Reuters Q3 revenue rises 9 pct to 736 mln.
newsitem.headline: Reuters Q3 revenue rises 9 pct to 736 mln.

text.p: International news and information organisation Reuters Holdings Plc said on Friday its revenue in the third quarter rose nine percent to 736 million pounds ($1.17 billion) from 677 million pounds previously.
Revenue for the first nine months increased by 10 percent to 2.174 billion pounds against 1.972 billion pounds in the 1995 period.
The company said in a statement that excluding exchange rate movements, growth in the third quarter was 10 percent.
The third quarter revenue growth showed a rise in installations of information management systems after the lower levels recorded in the first six months.

Reuters said it also saw increasing demand for its range of risk management products although revenue from information management systems provider TIBCO was held back as it introduced a new product line to extend its activities beyond the trading floor.

Growth in recurring revenue from information products was broadly maintained and showed a rise of seven percent for the first nine months, while Instinet, the equities trading system, achieved a 46 percent rise in revenue during a period, which saw a number of record trading days.
Reuters said currency markets generally remained featureless, holding back foreign exchange dealing services, while media revenue was impacted by the disposal of London Radio.
